Two-letter abbreviations are printed within state boundaries, including NC, NY, DE, IL, KY, WA, and TX.

public_definitions: Goal: Review the state prevalence dashboard, then open the state prevalence record that should be routed into the highest-prevalence priority follow-up workflow.
Routing criterion: Highest prevalence state in the dashboard
uncertain: The specific numerical prevalence value for each state is not printed on the map, only the color-coded category.
It is not explicitly stated which state has the absolute highest prevalence if multiple states share the same 'High' color category.
